about: The hare looks to the side, a fidget (HUNT_FAMILIES 7): from the idle's crouch the head alone turns toward the hare's right with the nose a little up, so the side view shows the face and both ears instead of the profile. One pose (`even` needs two or more, so a one-frame list), held 600 to 1200 ms; the other side is the down or up frame mirrored by the client (a horizontal flip of the sprite, as the right view is the left view mirrored), never a second render. Also the first fidget after a flight.
